jobs.title: Business Development Representative Intern
jobs.description:
Akur8 is a fast-growing InsurTech scale-up on a mission to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk.

Our next-generation SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and smart product design to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems.

Powered by expert engineering, data, product, and actuarial teams, Akur8 enables insurers to model risk up to 10x faster while maintaining transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust.

As our product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform supporting pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions — helping insurers operate efficiently in a complex environment.

Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in:

  • CB Insights’ Insurtech 50 (2025)

  • CNBC’s InsurTech Top 150 (2025)

  • InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025)

  • Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025)

With 40+ nationalities across 8 global offices, we serve 320+ clients across 4 continents while maintaining a strong engineering and product culture.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer, fostering an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives help shape better products and decisions.

As Akur8 continues to grow, we are looking for a Business Development Representative Intern to support our Sales team in identifying relevant prospects and creating new conversations with insurance professionals.

You will join an international Sales team focused on growing Akur8’s client base through new business, account development, and long-term relationships. You will work closely with Sales Directors, Sales Executives Marketing, Sales Operations, and our Actuarial experts. This internship will give you practical experience in B2B SaaS sales, prospecting, and the insurance technology market.

Your mission will include, but not be limited to, the following:

PROSPECT RESEARCH

• Identify insurance companies, reinsurers, brokers, and other relevant organisations that may benefit from Akur8’s solutions.

• Research target accounts, their business priorities, and the people involved in pricing, reserving, actuarial, data, and innovation projects.

• Build and maintain clear account lists to support focused outreach.

OUTBOUND BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

• Write personalised email and LinkedIn messages that speak to each prospect’s role and business context.

• Support outbound calling and follow-up campaigns with guidance from experienced sales colleagues.

• Test different messages, channels, and approaches, then share what you learn with the team.

LEAD QUALIFICATION AND HANDOFF

• Engage with prospects to understand their current processes, challenges, priorities, and potential timelines.

• Qualify early conversations against agreed criteria and identify relevant next steps.

• Schedule meetings for Account Executives and prepare clear handover notes so that each conversation starts with useful context.

SALES AND MARKETING COLLABORATION

• Work with Marketing on campaigns, webinars, events, and content aimed at insurance professionals.

• Share feedback from prospects to help improve messaging and campaign targeting.

• Support the Sales team with account mapping, event preparation, and follow-up activities.

• Support the preparation of client-facing slides and materials, review documents created by the team, and adapt content to address specific client needs.

CRM AND REPORTING

• Keep prospect and activity information accurate in the CRM.

• Track outreach, responses, meetings, and follow-up actions.

• Prepare simple activity reports and contribute ideas to improve the team’s day-to-day sales process.

You will be based in Paris and will work primarily from our office. Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, events, or conferences.

We are looking for someone who is curious about business, comfortable speaking with new people, and ready to learn through practice.

EDUCATIONAL / PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

• You are currently enrolled in a Business School, university, or equivalent programme and are looking for a full-time 6-month internship, with a starting date between October and December.

• You are interested in B2B sales, technology, insurance, or a role that combines business conversations with analytical thinking.

• You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you are comfortable adapting your message to different audiences.

• You are organized, persistent, and able to manage several follow-up tasks without losing track of details.

• You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and respond well to feedback.

• You enjoy working with colleagues from different countries and functions.

• You have strong spoken and written English & French. Additional language is a bonus.

BONUS SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

• A first experience in sales, business development, customer service, or another role involving outreach.

• Familiarity with a CRM, sales engagement platform, LinkedIn, or other tools used to research and contact prospects.

• Previous experience in an international company, student association, start-up, or technology environment.

• An interest in the insurance industry and in the way data can support better business decisions.

As a newcomer, you'll be joining a diverse, highly skilled and motivated team, with a strong Tech DNA, colleagues that are eager to share their knowledge and passion.

We care about strong teamwork and a positive day-to-day environment. The team regularly connects through optional activities such as team lunches, sports, karaoke, or occasional after-work gatherings.

jobs.title: Ingénieur(e) de recherche en Intelligence Artificielle appliquée à la vision 3D et au contrôle dimensionnel industriel - CDD 24 mois
jobs.description:
🚀 Rejoignez une institution d’excellence et d’innovation en tant qu’Ingénieur(e) de recherche en Intelligence Artificielle appliquée à la vision 3D et au contrôle dimensionnel industriel - CDD 24 mois.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

🎯Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant qu’ingénieur(e) de recherche en intelligence artificielle appliquée à la vision industrielle 3D, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche, innovation technologique et transfert vers l’industrie,   affecté(e) au Centre Fayol de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne.

Transitions numériques, écologiques, industrielles : les grands défis de notre époque sont aussi ceux de l’Institut Henri Fayol.

Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles. 

📊 Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles.

✨ Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre.

Au sein de ce centre de recherche pluridisciplinaire (plus de 80 personnes), reconnu pour son expertise en IA, systèmes cyber-physiques et sciences des données, vous contribuerez à des projets de R&D à fort impact pour l’industrie du futur. Le centre s’appuie notamment sur sa plateformes technologiques IT'M Factory et est un acteur-clé de l'enseignement et de l'innovation au sein de l’Institut Mines-Télécom.

 

Dans le cadre du projet régional DIGIMAN3D, financé par la Région Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, ce recrutement vise à développer et expérimenter une solution de contrôle dimensionnel 3D en ligne, basée sur l’acquisition de données 3D et l’intelligence artificielle, pour le contrôle automatisé de pièces mécaniques de précision en conditions industrielles.

 

Vos missions principales seront les suivantes :

· Vous assurez le développement et l’adaptation d’algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle appliqués aux données 3D et aux nuages de points, notamment pour la segmentation géométrique, l’identification des surfaces et la sélection des données pertinentes pour la mesure.

· Vous participez à la qualification des capteurs 3D et à la mise en place du banc d’essai expérimental, ainsi qu’aux campagnes d’acquisition et de caractérisation des données dans des environnements représentatifs des conditions industrielles.

· Vous contribuez au développement d’une chaîne hybride associant intelligence artificielle et méthodes géométriques analytiques, afin d’améliorer la précision, la robustesse et la répétabilité des mesures dimensionnelles, avec un objectif de précision inférieur à 20 µm.

· Vous participez à l’intégration et à l’évaluation des modèles développés sur banc d’essai, puis sur machine à commande numérique et en conditions réelles de production, en collaboration avec les partenaires du consortium.

· Vous rendez compte de vos travaux par des rapports techniques, des résultats expérimentaux, des démonstrateurs fonctionnels et des interactions régulières avec les partenaires scientifiques et industriels du projet.

 

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet, à interagir avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires et à faire dialoguer recherche, développement et application industrielle sera essentielle pour réussir.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’un :

·  Diplôme Bac +5 (école d’ingénieur ou master 2) en science de données, informatique, intelligence artificielle, traitement d’image.

 

Et idéalement :

· Avec une expérience de 1 à 3 ans dans le secteur de l’intelligence artificielle appliquée, notamment à des projets en vision par ordinateur, segmentation, ou détection d’anomalies.

Et vous possédez :

• Une expérience significative en développement d’algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle ou de vision par ordinateur.

• Une expérience confirmée en programmation Python avec des bibliothèques IA (PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV)

• Une expertise avérée en apprentissage non supervisé ou auto-supervisé, détection d’anomalies

• Une maîtrise de l’anglais technique (niveau B2 confirmé)

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

·  Connaissances en intégration sur matériel industriel (edge computing, GPU, PC embarqué)

·  Intérêt pour la transfert technologique et l'impact industriel concret

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

  • Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

  • Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

  • Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail.

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

jobs.title: Director of Sales, ITS, Europe
jobs.description:
Who is Seyond? 

 
Seyond is a leading global provider of image-grade LiDAR technology, powering a safer, smarter and more mobile world across the automotive, intelligent transportation, robotics and industrial automation sectors. Founded in Silicon Valley with strategically placed research and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Seyond is crafting LiDAR solutions that elevate autonomous driving and fuel the advancement of smart infrastructure development. Our dynamic portfolio – including ultra-long range flagship LiDAR sensor Falcon, mid-to-short range LiDAR sensor Robin and perception service software platform OmniVidi – powers automotive and ITS solutions for partners like NIO, Faraday Future, Exwayz and Hexagon. Currently, over 200,000 Falcon units are in use, and the product continues to be mass-produced today. 

 

Senior Director of Sales, Europe

SIMPL Business Unit — Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS)

Seyond

Location: Germany preferred (open to strong candidates elsewhere in Europe)

Reports to: Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business (ex-US/China)

Team: SIMPL Business Unit — LiDAR-based smart intersection and highway detection

Employment type: Full-time

About Seyond SIMPL

SIMPL is scaling its international footprint across Europe, APAC, and emerging markets, and is building out dedicated regional sales leadership to match the growth already underway in the Americas.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Director of Sales to build and lead SIMPL's sales function across Europe — a role modeled on the regional sales leadership Seyond has already established in the Americas. You will report directly to Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business, and will sit above SIMPL's country-level sales representatives across Europe, giving the region a single accountable sales leader for the first time.

This is a player-coach role. We need someone who has personally carried and exceeded a sales quota — not a candidate whose background is purely sales operations or account management — and who can also recruit, coach, and manage a small, distributed team of regional reps as the European organization scales.

What You'll Do

  • Build and lead SIMPL's European sales organization, recruiting, onboarding, and coaching country and regional sales representatives.
  • Personally own and close strategic opportunities while the regional team is being built out, transitioning toward a team-quota model as the organization scales.
  • Develop and execute go-to-market strategy across both SIMPL verticals: urban intersection management and inter-urban highway/tunnel/tolling detection.
  • Manage and grow relationships with European distributors, system integrators, and OEM partners, alongside direct engagement with end-user agencies and pilot customers.
  • Own the European sales pipeline and forecast in HubSpot, maintaining accurate deal ownership, stage progression, and close-date discipline.
  • Represent SIMPL at European trade shows, industry events, and customer meetings.
  • Partner with SIMPL's European engineering team on technical qualification and solution scoping for major opportunities.
  • Collaborate with the Head of Global ITS Business and BU leadership on regional pricing, deal structuring, and strategic account planning.
  • Establish clear rep-level KPIs that balance new-business generation with existing-account growth, supported by weekly activity tracking.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in ITS, smart infrastructure, industrial IoT/sensors, or another technical, tender-driven market.
  • A proven personal quota-carrying track record as an individual contributor — a genuine "hunter," not primarily an account manager or sales-ops leader.
  • Experience building or leading a distributed regional sales team, ideally spanning multiple European countries.
  • Comfort managing both channel relationships (distributors, OEMs, system integrators) and direct end-user/agency sales cycles.
  • Experience navigating public-sector or government tender processes is a strong plus.
  • Fluent English required; German or another major European language is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Nice to Have

  • An existing network in European traffic management, tolling, or highway agencies.
  • Experience selling LiDAR, radar, or other sensor-based detection technologies.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or a comparable CRM.

Compensation

Competitive base and incentive package, benchmarked to Director-level sales leadership roles in the European technology/industrial sector. Final compensation band to be confirmed following market benchmarking.

jobs.title: AI and Computer Vision Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

We want you as a hands-on AI and Computer Vision Engineer to build the perception capability behind autonomous close-proximity operations: models that estimate the relative position and orientation of non-cooperative spacecraft from camera images, trained largely on synthetic and lab data, and optimized to run on the compute we can actually fly.

This is a builder role. You write the training code, run the experiments, take the models onto embedded and neuromorphic hardware, and own the results.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as AI and Computer Vision Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • Designing, training and evaluating deep-learning models for 6-DoF pose estimation of non-cooperative spacecraft

  • Owning the full training pipeline: dataset generation and management, augmentation, domain adaptation between synthetic, laboratory and orbital imagery, experiment tracking and reproducibility.

  • Optimizing models for flight-representative compute (knowledge distillation, pruning, quantization and quantization-aware training) and benchmarking latency, memory and power against onboard constraints.

  • Porting and evaluating models on embedded and neuromorphic hardware, and characterizing the accuracy versus energy trade-off.

  • Building explainability and uncertainty into the pipeline so failure modes such as high occlusion can be debugged and the technology is a credible candidate for certification.

  • Exploring privacy-preserving and distributed training approaches that let us improve models with partners without exchanging raw data.

  • Prototyping lightweight self-supervised refinement methods for later in-flight model adaptation on unlabeled imagery.

  • Defining requirements, test scenarios and validation criteria together with GNC/FPO, and supporting the selection and characterization of space-qualified camera sensors.

  • Running validation campaigns on hardware-in-the-loop testbeds and analyzing the results.

  • Managing our training compute footprint across cloud GPU and internal HPC efficiently.

What we would love to see from you

In this role, ideally, you will have the following:

Education

  • Degree (MSc or PhD) in computer science, electrical engineering, robotics, aerospace, physics, or a comparable field with a strong machine learning focus.

Experience

  • 3+ years building and shipping deep-learning computer vision systems such as object detection, keypoint detection, pose estimation, or 3D perception. PhD work in the field counts.

  • Demonstrable experience taking a model from research prototype to a constrained target: quantization, distillation, latency optimization, deployment on embedded or accelerator hardware.

  • Experience training on synthetic data and dealing with the sim-to-real gap.

  • Hands-on lab work: cameras, calibration, test setups, collecting and annotating your own data.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong Python and PyTorch (or JAX/TensorFlow); clean, version-controlled, reproducible code.

  • Solid classical computer vision and 3D geometry: camera models, intrinsics and extrinsics, distortion, PnP, RANSAC, coordinate frames.

  • Comfortable with Linux, Git, containers, and running large training jobs on GPU clusters or in the cloud.

  • Genuinely hands-on and self-directed: you will carry your work largely on your own, with review support rather than daily direction.

  • Able to communicate results clearly in technical reports and reviews.

  • Working proficiency in English; German is a plus.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with spacecraft rendezvous, docking, or vision-based navigation, and with benchmarks such as SPEED/SPEED+ and the ESA pose estimation challenges.

  • Spiking neural networks and neuromorphic hardware, or event-based cameras.

  • Federated learning, differential privacy, or secure aggregation.

  • Rendering and synthetic data generation (Blender, Unreal Engine, Isaac Sim, …).

  • Experience with space or safety-critical software assurance, or with publicly funded R&D projects.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

jobs.title: Principal Counsel, Africa Legal
jobs.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. 

Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people's lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You and The Role

Zipline is seeking a senior, strategic, and highly adaptable lawyer to lead and scale legal and compliance across multiple countries of operation in Africa. This role sits at the intersection of compliance execution and regulatory strategy and is critical to enabling Zipline's continued growth in complex and evolving regulatory environments.

You will independently lead all Africa Legal & Compliance operations and strategy while serving as an integral member of Zipline International's high-impact Legal Team. You will also be a key member of the Zipline Africa Leadership Team, with the Heads of People and Finance and our Country Directors, and with a dotted reporting line to Zipline Africa's CEO. You will work cross-functionally with the Africa Leadership Team, Operations, Policy, Government Affairs, People, Finance, and Engineering, and will report directly to Zipline's Deputy General Counsel.

This is a hands-on leadership role that offers the rare opportunity to build and shape the Legal function with significant autonomy, while benefiting from the collaboration and support of a larger global legal team. One day you may be advising on a complex Nigerian employment or a healthcare regulatory issue in Cote d'Ivoire; the next, developing compliance training for teams across Africa or helping the business navigate export controls, sanctions, anti-corruption, and other cross-border legal risks.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, scale, and continuously improve Zipline's legal and compliance programs across Africa, with a focus on sustainable, practical operations that support rapid growth
  • Lead day-to-day compliance workstreams covering sanctions, anti-bribery and anti-corruption, privacy, healthcare, employment, and product-related regulations
  • Support internal investigations, audits, and risk assessments, partnering closely with People, Finance, and senior leadership
  • Manage litigation and disputes across Zipline's African markets 
  • Translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for business and technical teams
  • Own compliance with U.S. government award requirements, including FARs and 2 CFR 200, and serve as a primary point of contact for U.S. government contracting officers (including at the U.S. Department of State)
  • Monitor and assess regulatory and policy developments across relevant African jurisdictions and advise leadership on emerging risks and opportunities

Cross-Functional Partnership & Culture

  • Act as a senior legal advisor to business leaders, providing pragmatic, risk-calibrated guidance 
  • Build strong relationships across the company and help foster a durable "culture of compliance" where teams understand the rules of the road and feel empowered to raise issues early
  • Help shape Zipline's long-term legal and regulatory strategy in Africa, balancing compliance rigor with innovation and speed

What You'll Bring

  • A willingness to dive deep into unfamiliar issues and operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-environments
  • Strong judgment and the confidence to make independent decisions, coupled with the discernment to escalate when appropriate
  • Experience advising on legal and compliance matters, preferably in international or emerging-market environments
  • The ability to break down complex legal and regulatory problems into clear priorities and practical solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to advise senior stakeholders
  • A collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset and strong organizational skills
  • Willingness to travel up to ~25% to Africa and San Francisco headquarters

What Else You Need To Know

LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

 

Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

 

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).

 

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

 

VOTRE RÔLE

Au sein du pôle Développement Maroquinerie, le/la Chef(fe) de produit est garant(e), du développement des produits et du suivi des collections. En lien direct avec la Responsable Développement Maroquinerie, il/elle intervient de manière autonome sur l'ensemble de son périmètre, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes, Création Produit, Merchandising et Production.

 

VOS MISSIONS  

  • Travail en autonomie sur les offres maroquinerie homme, petite maroquinerie, ceintures et projets VIP
  • Accompagnement des fabricants dans le développement des produits, sur la base du brief du studio et du brief merchandising, déplacements sur site à prévoir
  • Gestion du parc de fabricants en collaboration avec l’équipe production (identification des forces et faiblesses, contretype)
  • Propositions d’alternatives techniques auprès du studio et des fabricants, pour anticiper les problématiques industrialisation et costing dans le respect de l’intention créative
  • Pilotage du développement des prototypes et des échantillons dans le respect des délais, de la marge et du niveau de qualité
  • Visibilité prix tout au long de la collection et négociations dans le respect des objectifs de marge
  • En charge du référencements produits et garant de l’exactitude des nomenclatures produits
  • Mise à jour des plans de collection et outils de suivi de collections
  • Support argumentaires spécificités produits pour l’équipe merchandising
  • Gestion planning shooting packshot et conformité produit en lien avec l’équipe image
  • Participation aux organisations défilé (pointage collection, mises en place produit pour editing styling et fitting, packing collection)
  • Préparation et transmission des dossiers techniques aux équipes industrialisation et production.
  • Validations facture et suivi rigoureux des coûts engagés
  • Participation à l’amélioration en continue des process

 

VOTRE PROFIL

  • Bac +3 à Bac +5 (commerce, mode ou équivalent), avec 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en développement produit maroquinerie et/ou petite maroquinerie, idéalement dans l'univers du luxe ou de la mode

 

  • Bonne connaissance du marché et de ses acteurs

 

  • Expérience en gestion fabricants, développement produits et analyse de dossiers techniques

 

  • Maîtrise d'Excel et des outils bureautiques ; connaissance d'un ERP/PLM fortement appréciée

 

  • Anglais professionnel indispensable, italien fortement apprécié

 

  • Forte sensibilité produit alliée à une organisation rigoureuse et un bon sens des priorités

 

  • Aisance relationnelle, esprit d'équipe, proactivité, flexibilité et sens des responsabilités

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Offer Operations
jobs.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 6 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🦾 Our Offer Operations team

Joko helps millions of users earn cashback automatically, whether they shop online through affiliate links, activate coupons, or pay in-store with their linked bank card. Behind each of these experiences, there's an operational engine that needs to work flawlessly: transactions must be tracked, cashback must be caught, offers must be reliable, and merchants must perform as expected. When this engine breaks, users don't get paid — and trust erodes fast.

Offer Operations owns that engine. The team's mission is to guarantee the reliability and continuous improvement of Joko's core monetization mechanics — across affiliate tracking, coupons, card-linked bank integrations, gift cards, and merchant performance. It's a technical, data-heavy, high-stakes scope that sits right at the heart of what makes Joko's product work.

🎯 What you will do

As an Operations Manager, your main mission is to own one of the processes that decides whether millions of Joko users actually get the cashback they're owed. You'll report to David Le Pahun, our Offer Operations Lead. The role blends four things: analysing data, designing how the process should work, solving problems with AI, technologies or in the last resort outsourcing, and managing projects.

  • Analyse data. You'll build the dashboards that tell you — and everyone else — whether your part of the system is healthy: how many transactions are being correctly tracked and rewarded, what's silently breaking down, whether user experience is suffering.

  • Design the process. You decide how merchants get set up on our platform: their cashback rate, which purchases qualify, how we connect to their systems. A lot of this doesn't have a playbook yet — you'll be writing a good chunk of it as you go.

  • Solve problems with technology. A merchant might be showing users a coupon that doesn't actually pay out. A batch of card purchases might not match cleanly to any merchant we track. You'll dig into why, then fix it choosing the right solution for it: automating it with AI, improving one of our internal tools (built on Retool) and if a human is required, you'll build the right playbook to outsource it.

  • Manage outsourced resources. You'll manage the outsourced team members who help you operate at scale — briefing them, training them, checking their work is actually good — while juggling several of these issues at once and deciding what matters most.

  • Partner cross-functionally. With Product & Engineering when the fix is structural, and with the commercial team when it's really about a merchant relationship.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: around 2–5 years of experience, ideally with exposure to Operations, Product, or a technical/data-driven environment.

  • AI-native: you genuinely believe in what AI can do, and you already use it as part of how you work — not as a buzzword, but as a real way to automate the repetitive parts of your job and move faster on the rest.

  • Ops mindset: you think in systems — monitoring → detection → investigation → resolution → prevention. You instinctively look for what can break and build safeguards so it doesn't happen again.

  • Tech acumen: you're comfortable in a technical environment — tracking, APIs, integrations — and can hold your own in a conversation with Engineering.

  • Analytical skills: you're data-driven and comfortable navigating dashboards, investigating anomalies, and making decisions based on metrics.

  • Attention to detail: the devil is in the details, and you have a talent for spotting flaws where others don't.

  • Communication: clear written and verbal communication skills; you're not afraid to defend your decisions with demanding stakeholders (including merchants and the outsourced teams you'll be directing).

  • Education: Top-tier engineering or business school background. International experience and a double degree are a clear plus.

  • Languages: fluent in written and spoken English. Mastering French is not required.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €41.2K – €73.4K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Processor Software Stack)
jobs.description:
At Ubitium, we believe the best engineering happens when people with different perspectives tackle hard problems together. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. What matters most is curiosity, skill, and the drive to build technology that improves the world. If that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you. Our team members come from some of the best universities in the world and left some of the largest tech companies to build something truly remarkable.

Tasks

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is at home across our processor software from ported libraries and the compiler down to bare-metal and operating systems. Your team will: develop our software stack, including compiler, mapping tools, low-level tooling, simulation and debug infrastructure; write bare-metal, firmware and OS-level software for our RISC-V SoC; implement and optimise signal-processing and inference kernels under real-time constraints; bring up, test and port software on pre-silicon platforms and on silicon, including low-level hardware tests; and work in a close feedback loop with our hardware designers.

Requirements

  • Strong C, modern C++ (C++17/20, STL, Boost) and Python.
  • A solid foundation in algorithms and in hardware/software system architecture.
  • Experience working close to the hardware, with a good understanding of system-on-a-chip design, processor architecture and microarchitecture, and some familiarity with RTL and hardware design.
  • Experience with agentic programming.
  • You know your way around all of these fields, and go deep in at least one: i ) compiler development and code generation; ii) low-level tooling, simulation and performance analysis; iii) low-level embedded or systems software, operating systems and real-time; iv) signal processing, numerical computation and ML inference
  • Master's degree (or equivalent experience) and 10+ years of relevant experience.
  • Relocation required. Currently 4 days on-site, 1 day remote. Policy may change.

Nice to have

  • Parallel and data-flow execution models: SIMT, predicated execution, branch divergence.
  • Mapping and optimisation algorithms: graph algorithms, place-and-route / EDA, CGRA or FPGA mapping, ILP solvers.
  • Kernel-level optimisation: vectorisation, data layout, memory hierarchy, fixed-point and quantised arithmetic.
  • Post-silicon validation and hardware bring-up, including directed and random test generation.
  • Porting code to new platforms.
  • Exposure to: RISC-V, LLVM, CUDA, OpenCL, Verilog, Verilator, QEMU, GDB, JTAG and on-chip debug, OpenSBI, bootloaders, HAL, Linux kernel and device drivers, device tree, Zephyr, Yocto/OpenEmbedded, BLAS/LAPACK/OpenBLAS.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary plus stock options
  • 30+ days of paid vacation
  • Relocation support
  • Full German social security and universal healthcare
  • A modern office
  • Free snacks, coffee, and drinks
  • Work with people who actually know their stuff – computer architects, hardware nerds, and engineers who love tough problems.
  • A culture where new ideas matter, but so does respect and collaboration.
  • Space to grow: pick up new skills, dig into areas that interest you, and shape your own path.
  • Get hands-on with real implementations of AI and signal processing – not just slides or buzzwords.
  • An inclusive team where different perspectives are valued and everyone contributes.

We are constantly looking for talent. We recruit through multiple channels – friends & colleagues, universities and professors we know, recruiters, conventions, e-mails and LinkedIn. Join us today.

• Enge Begleitung durch erfahrene Kolleg:innen aus dem Accounting

High-Growth Story – bonial ist ein wachstumsstarkes und dynamisches Unternehmen mit dauerhaftem Potenzial für die Zukunft. Wir sind eines der führenden Unternehmen und eine treibende Kraft in einer Branche, die gerade einen massiven, einmaligen Wandel von Print zu Digital erlebt.

Spannendes Umfeld für Deine berufliche Entwicklung – Wir unterstützen Dich stark in Deiner beruflichen Entwicklung, gestützt von einer Feedback-Kultur, die Dir hilft, Deine Stärken und Chancen zu erkennen.

Diversität - Wir sind stolz darauf, ein Arbeitsplatz für Chancengleichheit zu sein, an dem wir es jeder Person ermöglichen möchten, ihr wahres selbst zu zeigen. Außerdem brauchst Du Dir keine Sorgen um Deine Rente machen, denn wir bezuschussen Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Zusätzlich zu unserem internen Fitnesstudio, übernehmen wir auch einen Teil der Kosten für Urban Sports Club.

Gemeinsam wollen wir unseren Beitrag leisten und den Planeten so positiv beeinflussen, wie wir nur können.

Flexibilität – Aktuell haben wir eine Regelung, die wöchentlich bis zu 20% mobiles Arbeiten innerhalb Deutschlands ermöglicht. Dazu darfst Du 30 Tage pro Jahr aus dem Ausland arbeiten. jobs.title: Business Development Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
To further strengthen our growth and unlock new business potential, we are looking for an entrepreneurial, strategically minded and persuasive personality to join us as soon as possible as a Business Development Manager (m/f/d). In this role, you will actively help expand our business activities with market insight, strong negotiation skills and enthusiasm for innovative energy solutions.

Tasks

  • Identifying, evaluating, qualifying and developing new business opportunities in the fields of hydrogen, energy storage and renewable energies
  • Identifying and developing new customer, partner and project structures as well as maintaining long-term stakeholder relationships, including the development of formal partnerships
  • Analysing markets, customer needs, competition and regulatory conditions to derive concrete growth opportunities and actions
  • Developing go-to-market, partnership and market-entry strategies in national and international environments
  • Supporting the acquisition, conceptualisation and commercial development of hydrogen and storage projects
  • Preparing business cases, decision-making materials as well as market and profitability analyses
  • Preparing and conducting customer and partner meetings, presentations and negotiations
  • Working closely with Engineering, Project Management and the Management Board to implement new business approaches
  • Representing RCT GH at conferences and trade fairs

Requirements

  • A completed degree in industrial engineering, energy technology, mechanical engineering, chemical or process engineering or a comparable field
  • Several years of experience in business development, strategic sales, partner management or project business, ideally in the energy sector, hydrogen, gas process plants or comparable fields
  • Strong understanding of complex sales cycles, capital equipment and/or process technology sales
  • Sound understanding of energy markets, business models and commercial and legal interrelationships
  • Interest in hydrogen technologies, renewable energies and the energy transition
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, strong analytical skills and a high level of initiative
  • Confident presence, strong communication skills and negotiation ability
  • Independent, structured and goal-oriented way of working
  • Business-fluent German and English skills as well as willingness to travel. Additional languages are a plus
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM tools

Benefits

  • A varied and responsible role in a future-oriented technology environment
  • The opportunity to actively contribute to innovative solutions for the energy supply of the future
  • A dynamic, committed team with short decision-making paths and an open, collegial company culture
  • A challenging area of responsibility with a high degree of autonomy and plenty of room to shape your work
  • Attractive and performance-based remuneration
  • An attractive workplace in Konstanz within a high-growth company environment
  • The chance to actively help shape market expansion in hydrogen storage technology

We offer you the opportunity to apply your business development experience in a technologically demanding and forward-looking market environment, actively develop new business potential and work with us to drive the expansion of innovative hydrogen solutions.

jobs.title: Head of Operations & Service - Dosimetry
jobs.description:
General Mission

Reporting to the Business Unit President, the Head of Operations & Service is responsible for defining and executing the global operations strategy to support the growth, profitability and customer satisfaction objectives of the Dosimetry business. The role ensures the effective management of worldwide manufacturing, supply chain, order fulfillment and customer service activities, while building a resilient and scalable operational model. As a member of the Dosimetry leadership team, the position works closely with the Radiotherapy (RT) and Medical Imaging (MI) Business line, Finance, R&D, Quality and Regulatory Affairs, Business Unit President and People function to align operational priorities with business needs.

Tasks

  • Lead and continuously optimize worldwide manufacturing and supply chain operations across production sites in the United States, Germany and China, ensuring reliable product availability, operational efficiency and business continuity.
  • Define the long-term manufacturing footprint and sourcing strategy, including make-versus-buy decisions, component manufacturing approaches, and production site allocation.
  • Partner with Finance and MI – RT Business Lines to align demand forecasts, production planning and delivery commitments, ensuring accurate capacity planning and execution.
  • Lead global customer service organizations across the United States, Germany, India and China, ensuring a seamless customer experience and responsive support across all regions.
  • Oversee end-to-end order fulfillment processes from order intake to delivery, driving operational excellence, process standardization, and continuous improvement. Establish a performance-driven culture through the use of operational metrics, effective governance, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Build, develop and lead international teams, fostering accountability, collaboration and engagement.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, quality standards, regulatory requirements and health and safety guidelines.
  • Support and promote IBA values while contributing to the achievement of the overall Dosimetry business strategy.

Requirements

  • Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business objectives into operational strategy
  • Strong leadership and people management skills in an international and multicultural environment
  • Expertise in manufacturing, supply chain, customer service and operations management
  • Business acumen with strong understanding of forecasting, planning and financial drivers
  • Customer-centric approach with a focus on service excellence
  • Ability to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement
  • Strong decision-making and problem-solving capabilities
  • Influencing and stakeholder management skills across functions and geographies
  • Ability to manage complexity, balance priorities and deliver results
  • Accountability and ownership with a strong focus on execution and outcomes
  • Fluent in English and German language

Benefits

Diverse and challenging tasks / personal responsibility and teamwork / international and dynamic team / regular internal and external training - development and coaching / flexible working hours and home office / healthy breakfast and team events / a remuneration system that rewards your success/ 30 vacation days

Please apply directly online with salary expectation and start day.

Please note that we only accept online applications. Written application documents sent nevertheless will not be included in the application process and will not be returned.

Thank you for your understanding!

If you have any questions, please turn to Onyinye Nfiaji directly in LinkedIn.
